SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CORE_SECTION.title: Core systems
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUN_SECTION.title: Run
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_REQUIEM_SYSTEMS.ho: Stamina, Mana and Requiem statuses for Ironclad, Silent and Regent.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_OVERSTRAIN.title: Overstrain
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_OVERSTRAIN.hover.d: Attacking without enough Stamina costs 2 HP per missing point.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHORT_RUN.title: Short run (acts 1-3-5)
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHORT_RUN.hover.title: Short run
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHORT_RUN.hover.desc: Acts 1 → 3 → 5 only (Foothills, Hive, Glory) with the mod's overlays. Overrides Five acts.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERO_SECTION.title: Heroes
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REGENT_ORIGIN.title: Regent origin
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REGENT_ORIGIN.hover.title: Regent origin
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REGENT_ORIGIN.hover.desc: "Choose" shows a relic selection screen when the run starts.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AUTO_DODGE.title: Auto-dodge
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AUTO_DODGE.hover.title: Auto-dodge
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AUTO_DODGE.hover.desc: Spend a Dodge charge and 2 ◆ automatically when an attack would hit your HP. Off — Dodge never triggers.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PLATEBEARER_ORIGIN.title: Platebearer clan
Until the origin select screen exists, the origin is taken from here.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SILENT_ORIGIN.title: Silent tribe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SILENT_ORIGIN.hover.title: Silent tribe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SILENT_ORIGIN.hover.desc: "Choose" shows a relic selection screen when the run starts.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BACKGROUND.title: Background
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BACKGROUND.hover.title: Background
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BACKGROUND.hover.desc: 1st/2nd/3rd background of the chosen origin, or Vagrant. Unfinished backgrounds are replaced with a random ready one. "Choose" shows a relic selection screen when the run starts.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOP_VARIETY.title: Requiem shops
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOP_VARIETY.hover.title: Requiem shops
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOP_VARIETY.hover.desc: Each shop is a Wanderer, Armorer, Arcanist or Herbalist with its own stock; trust discounts; selling backpack gear; combat gold ×1.3. Off — vanilla shops.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DEATH_SECTION.title: Death and the Memory Stone
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_MEMORY_STONE.title: Memory Stone
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_MEMORY_STONE.hover: Imprint at the start of every act; after death you may return to it for a Candle and a Scar. The act gets a new map, the boss stays. In co-op the host proposes, the party votes, Candles are shared.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_CANDLES.hove: Returns per run. −1 — by level (0: unlimited, 1–4: 3, 5–7: 2, 8–9: 1, 10: none). 0 — classic roguelike.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ALLOW_THEFT.title: Theft in shops
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ALLOW_THEFT.hover.title: Theft in shops
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ALLOW_THEFT.hover.desc: Click an item you can't afford to try stealing it (80% −10% per 50 gold, once per shop). Later theft will come from relics and origins; this switch allows it without them. Must match in co-op.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_PANTHEON.title: Pantheon
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENABLE_PANTHEON.hover.des: An Omen at Neow; from act 2 some «?» become Shrines, Dark Shrines and Six Stones by the Water. Must match in co-op.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIVE_ACTS.title: Five acts
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIVE_ACTS.hover.title: Five acts
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIVE_ACTS.hover.desc: Foothills → Frozen Barrows or Clockwork Depths → Hive → Blood Court or Star Tower → Glory. Off — the vanilla three acts.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REQUIEM_LEVEL_SETTING.hov: −1 — by Ascension (Ascension N → level N+1). 0 Wanderer: −25% enemy HP and damage taken. 5: travel fatigue. 7: elites get 2–3 affixes, +25% damage taken. 8: all Omens. 10: −20% damage dealt, the portal is mandatory, Tainted start, no Candles.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUPERBOSSES.title: Crimson Portal
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUPERBOSSES.hover.title: Crimson Portal
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUPERBOSSES.hover.desc: Superbosses after each act boss. Optional — you are asked (in co-op the portal is always entered).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIDE_MAPS.title: Wide maps
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIDE_MAPS.hover.title: Wide maps
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIDE_MAPS.hover.desc: Maps of the new acts are 9 columns wide (more paths and ? rooms). Off — 7 columns.
In the mod they are transformation forms (Lich, Clockwork Heart), so they are hidden on the character select screen and their cards never appear in rewards. On — bring them back as vanilla heroes (the mod's systems do not apply to them). Must match in co-op.
